privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Missio collects, uses and protects your information.

spans.text: At
Missio
, we are committed to protecting the privacy of all users — nonprofits, businesses, and individuals — who trust us to power their growth and impact.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal information when you use the
Missio platform
, including modules like
Talent IQ
, CRM, fundraising tools, and our website builder. Our goal is to be fully transparent while providing you control over your data.
By using our platform, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
A. Information You Provide
We collect personal and organisational information you provide when you:

items.text: Sign up for a Missio account
Use our Talent IQ, CRM, or campaign tools
Fill out forms, assessments, or contact support

spans.text: This includes:

items.text: Job title, resume, profile details (for Talent IQ)

spans.text: B. Automatically Collected Data
When you access Missio, we automatically collect:

items.text: Pages visited, time spent, and interactions

spans.text: C. Talent IQ-Specific Data
If you use
Talent IQ
, we may collect:

items.text: Resume content and AI match results

spans.text: We only store this data in your secure workspace and do not share it without your consent.
We use your data to:

items.text: Provide and personalise the Missio platform
Enable AI-based matching and insights in Talent IQ
Respond to inquiries and support requests
Comply with legal and regulatory requirements

spans.text: We
do not sell or rent your personal information
to any third party.
We only share your data in the following cases:

items.text: With your team members or users in your organisation
With trusted third-party vendors (e.g., cloud storage, analytics)
When required by law, regulation, or legal process
If you opt to publish content or profiles publicly (e.g., job listings)

spans.text: All third-party partners are bound by confidentiality and data protection agreements.
We take data protection seriously and implement best practices, including:

items.text: Encrypted data storage (at rest and in transit)
Role-based access control and multi-factor authentication
Routine security audits and vulnerability testing

spans.text: Access to
Talent IQ
data is restricted to authorised users only.
You can manage your data through your Missio account or by contacting us.
Your rights include:

items.text: Withdrawing consent for certain types of processing

spans.text: To exercise your rights, email:
privacy@missio.io
We use cookies and similar technologies to:

items.text: Improve UX across modules like Talent IQ

spans.text: You may disable cookies in your browser, though some features may not function properly.
Missio is not designed for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from minors. If you believe a child has submitted data, please contact us immediately and we will remove it.
Your data may be stored or processed in data centers outside your home country. We ensure all transfers comply with applicable privacy laws such as GDPR.
We retain data only for as long as needed to:
You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time.
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Major updates will be communicated via email or in-app notifications. The most current version is always available at
www.missio.io/privacy-policy
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests related to your privacy:
Email:
privacy@missio.io  🌐
Website:
www.missio.io

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms that govern your use of Missio.

security.title: Security
security.description: How Missio approaches the security of your data.

spans.text: Protecting the donor, volunteer and staff data our customers trust us with is a core part of how we build Missio.
Data is encrypted in transit using industry-standard protocols. Access to production systems is restricted to authorized personnel.
Missio supports role-based permissions, so your organization controls exactly what each staff member can see and do within the platform.
We monitor our systems for unusual activity and maintain a process for responding to and communicating about security incidents.
If you believe you've found a security issue, please
contact us
— we take every report seriously.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Our commitment to making Missio usable by everyone.

spans.text: We want Missio, and the pages our customers build with it, to be usable by as many people as possible, including people with disabilities.
We aim to follow established accessibility guidelines (such as WCAG 2.1) in the design of our own product and marketing pages, and we're continuing to improve as we go.
Accessibility isn't a one-time project — we review and improve it as part of how we build. If you encounter a barrier using Missio, we want to know about it.
If you experience an accessibility issue on this site or within the Missio platform, please
reach out
and describe what you encountered. We'll follow up.

cookie-preferences.title: Cookie Preferences
cookie-preferences.description: How Missio uses cookies, and how to manage them.

spans.text: Missio, Inc. (“Missio,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) uses cookies and similar technologies on our websites, applications, and online services (collectively, the “Services”) to provide, maintain, secure, and improve our Services and to understand how visitors use our website.
This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how Missio uses them, the types of cookies we may use, and how you can manage your cookie preferences.

By continuing to use our website, you may be consenting to the use of cookies as described in this policy, depending on your location and applicable law. Where required by law, we will request your consent before placing non-essential cookies on your device.

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer, smartphone, tablet, or other device when you visit a website. Cookies allow a website to recognize your device and remember certain information about your visit.
We may also use similar technologies, including pixels, tags, web beacons, local storage, and similar technologies, for purposes comparable to cookies.
Cookies may be:

items.text: Session cookies, which are deleted when you close your browser; or
Persistent cookies, which remain on your device for a specified period or until you delete them.
Missio may use cookies and similar technologies to:
Make our website and Services function properly;
Maintain your session and remember your preferences;
Maintain the security and integrity of our Services;
Understand how visitors interact with our website;
Measure website performance and improve our Services;
Analyze the effectiveness of our website and marketing efforts; and
Detect, prevent, and investigate fraudulent or unauthorized activity.

spans.text: A. Strictly Necessary Cookies
These cookies are required for the website or Services to function properly.
They may be used to:

items.text: Process transactions or other requested services.

spans.text: Because these cookies are necessary for the operation of the Services, they generally cannot be disabled through our cookie preference tools.
B. Functional Cookies
Functional cookies allow the website to remember choices you make and provide enhanced and more personalized functionality.
For example, these cookies may remember:

items.text: Other preferences necessary to provide requested functionality.

spans.text: If you disable these cookies, some features of the website may not function as intended.
C. Analytics and Performance Cookies
Analytics and performance cookies help us understand how visitors use our website.
These cookies may collect information such as:
We use this information to understand website performance, identify areas for improvement, and improve the overall user experience.
Where required by applicable law, we will obtain your consent before placing analytics cookies on your device.
D. Advertising and Marketing Cookies
Advertising and marketing cookies may be used to understand your interests, measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns, and provide more relevant communications or advertisements.
These technologies may allow us or our service providers and advertising partners to:

items.text: Build or infer audience information; and

spans.text: Marketing cookies will be used only where permitted by applicable law and, where required, after obtaining your consent.
Some cookies may be placed by third-party service providers that perform services on our behalf or provide functionality used on our website.
These third parties may include providers supporting functions such as:
Third-party providers may use cookies or similar technologies in accordance with their own privacy policies.
We do not control the cookies placed by third parties, and their use may be subject to their respective policies and terms.
Where applicable, you can manage your cookie preferences through the Cookie Preferences controls available on our website.
Depending on your location, you may be able to:

items.text: Enable or disable functional cookies; and
Enable or disable advertising or marketing cookies.

spans.text: Your choices regarding non-essential cookies will not affect your ability to use features that are necessary to provide the Services, although certain functionality may not work properly if optional cookies are disabled.
You can change your cookie preferences at any time by accessing the Cookie Preferences option available on our website.
You may also control or delete cookies through your web browser.
Most browsers allow you to:

items.text: View cookies stored on your device;
Receive a notification before a cookie is stored.

spans.text: Please note that disabling or deleting cookies may affect the functionality and availability of certain website features.
Some browsers offer a “Do Not Track” (“DNT”) setting. Because there is currently no universally accepted standard for responding to DNT signals, our website may not respond to all DNT signals.
Where required by applicable law, we will honor applicable privacy choices and rights in accordance with our Privacy Policy and applicable regulations.

sections.title: Cookies Used in the Missio Platform

spans.text: Missio provides software and online tools that may be used by organizations for fundraising, donor management, events, e-commerce, financial processes, communications, and other organizational activities.
Cookies and similar technologies used within authenticated areas of the Services may be necessary to:
The use of cookies within a customer’s Missio account may also depend on how that customer has configured and uses the Services.
Missio customers may use Missio technology to create or operate websites, donation pages, event pages, forms, or other online experiences.
In those circumstances, the organization operating the applicable website or service may have its own privacy and cookie practices.

If you interact with a website or page operated by a Missio customer, you should review that organization’s privacy notice and cookie policy for information about how it collects and uses information.

Information collected through cookies may include information about your device, browser, IP address, approximate location, pages viewed, interactions with the website, and other technical or usage information.
Depending on the type of cookie and the circumstances in which it is used, this information may be associated with other information we maintain about you.
For more information about how Missio collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information, please review our Privacy Policy.
The length of time a cookie remains on your device depends on whether it is a session cookie or persistent cookie and on the purpose for which it is used.

We retain information collected through cookies only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by applicable law.
We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our Services, technology, legal requirements, or our privacy practices.
When we make changes, we will update the Last Updated date at the top of this policy.
We encourage you to review this Cookie Policy periodically to stay informed about how we use cookies and similar technologies.

data-processing.title: Data Processing
data-processing.description: How Missio processes data on behalf of your organization.

spans.text: This page provides a general overview of our data processing practices. It is a starting template and should be reviewed by legal counsel before being relied upon as an official Data Processing Agreement.

When your organization uses Missio to store donor, volunteer or staff records, we act as a data processor on your behalf — we process that data to provide the service, not for our own independent purposes.

We rely on a small number of trusted infrastructure and service providers to operate Missio, such as hosting and payment processing. We select these providers carefully and expect them to meet the same standards we hold ourselves to.
We retain your organization's data for as long as your account is active, and for a reasonable period after account closure to allow for data export, unless a shorter period is required by law.
If your organization requires a signed Data Processing Agreement,
contact us
and we'll provide one.
